## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run validate` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] No content copied from the real test, prediction files or other practice platforms
- [ ] Scores shown, if any, carry the practice-estimate disclaimer
- [ ] Nothing a learner records or writes leaves their device without opt-in
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are explained and have a permissive licence

## New or changed questions

- [ ] Each question has `source`, `license`, `author` and, unless original, `source_url` and `attribution`
- [ ] `originality_confirmed: true` is honest
- [ ] Reviewers: two people other than the author, using the checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md
